Admin Panel.desc: No encounter. Gives you access to admin panel.

Up The Ante.desc: Be more cautious as node spawns more often.

Up The Hate.desc: Be extra cautious as node spawn very often.

So Much Variety.desc: Listen carefully as normal Angler will no longer spawn.

Sneak Attack.desc: Check which side the node came from, anything can attack from the front.

Hunted.desc: Volume up to listen for strong wind noise, added Pipsqueak to the roster.

GOM.desc: Hide in a locker when blue timer hit zero, loses HP if not.

Tight Security.desc: Must use passcode for all doors, keycard no longer spawns.

Light Work.desc: Less lit room, may need extra audio cue.

Forgot To Pay The Bills.desc: No lit rooms, audio cue is now always needed.

Closed For The Night.desc: Sebastian doesn't spawn anymore, his room still does.

Paranoia.desc: You must time your hiding, else you'll be pushed out quickly.

Good People Don't End Up Here.desc: Listen to fake doors, no static lights and spawn more often.

Redeemer.desc: No one quite sure what this does, guessing it spawns more.

Turret Upgrades.desc: Must look at the turret facing direction, no laser.

Free Trial.desc: Find place to hide when timer is about to hit zero, as it'll show advertisement.
